title: Concept: SHA-1 selected by name (go) — review required
description: In go, naming SHA-1 (h := sha1.New()) requests a deprecated digest. Name-selected digests hide inside factory calls, so reviewers must check the string. The go-specific remedy is selecting sha256.New().
applicability: go codebases selecting digests by name; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged digests where security is assumed; LOW default severity, raised when the digest guards trust.
